The '''Imperial Dynasty of Saochai''' is the map-facing title for the Saochai/Saochi state in central Avant.

The 2003 and 2022 map references label the country as the Imperial Dynasty of Saochai. The old Kaonism source refers to the ideology's birthplace as the Kingdom of Saochi. This draft treats Saochi and Saochai as variant source names for the same political-cultural space until the user rules otherwise.

== Kaonist Origin Context ==

During the [[Saochian Reorganization Period]] of the mid-nineteenth century, famine, fractured administration, urban unrest, and agrarian decline created the conditions in which [[Liao Zhengyuan]] formulated [[Kaonism]].

The source says Kaonism failed to gain mass support in Saochi itself. Its later importance came through exile, academic memory, and its influence on the political Taoist tradition connected to [[People's Federation of Xanaqu|Xanaqu]].

== Open Canon ==

This page is a bridge only. Saochai needs a full state-history article before publication, including its government form, dynastic chronology, relationship to the 1865 purge, and map-era institutions.
